Even with no tags to suggest yet, it tells me plainly I can just type one and press Enter — I typed "research", hit Enter, it turned into a tidy tag chip, and saving kept it on the bookmark. The little note that new tags get suggested next time sets the right expectation, and I like that it tidies the tag to lowercase so I don't end up with "Research" and "research" as two different things. That's exactly how I'd want to start tagging.
